counterfactual.admissible_for: partition structure only — island count, claimed nodes and dispatch count are decided before a shader runs, so the unproven flag cannot bias them
counterfactual.not_admissible_for: any correctness or performance claim about Relu on Vulkan: §8.9 forbids quoting a form from a run that needed ONNXRUNTIME_EP_VULKAN_CLAIM_UNPROVEN, and epctl --check-counters would require --allow-unproven to pass it

transfer_nodes.note: ORT inserts MemcpyToHost/MemcpyFromHost at EP boundaries; their cost is the price of partition fragmentation and is attributed separately here

Relu.cause: no proof-ledger entry for `ai.onnx::Relu/6+/f32>f32/ew_unary_relu_f32/runtime-extent/n1`. The shader exists and loads; §8.9's gate declines it because nothing has proven it correct on this form, so ORT places it on the CPU EP.

GlobalAveragePool.cause: claimed by the predicate, then dropped by the partition heuristic: once the 49 `Relu` declines had shattered the trunk, this node was left in a 1-node subgraph with no compute-heavy anchor (minimum 4). It is a *consequence* of the `Relu` gap, not an independent one.
GlobalAveragePool.closes_by: closing the Relu gap (the anchor rule then has a subgraph to hold on to)

MaxPool.cause: no Vulkan handler is registered for `MaxPool` (opset 12).

Flatten.cause: no Vulkan handler is registered for `Flatten` (opset 11).
Flatten.closes_by: implementing a Flatten kernel (a reshape; it moves no data)

static_support_census.derivation: op-type histogram of the UNOPTIMISED pinned graph, matched against `epctl --dump-capabilities --json` from the built EP, on the `has_kernel` predicate (NOT the deprecated `status == "live"` token, which is false for the `ready` rows that carry ResNet-50's Conv)
static_support_census.upper_bound_note: an upper bound on Vulkan coverage and nothing else: registration is necessary, not sufficient — the per-node claim predicate may still decline, and ORT's optimiser rewrites the graph first

checks.name: outputs_agree_with_cpu
checks.detail: equivalence gate = PASS; every timed arm was classified against the CPU EP reference before it was timed

checks.name: vulkan_production_dispatch_witness
checks.detail: dispatches_executed = 210 from the EP's own counters; a Vulkan row with no dispatch is a CPU row wearing the EP's name

checks.name: cuda_arm_executed
checks.detail: ORT's per-node provider attribution placed at least one node on CUDAExecutionProvider

checks.name: device_identified
checks.detail: the running device is named by stable identity, not by enumeration index

checks.name: enough_repeats
checks.detail: repeats=5, iters_per_repeat=10; a median without repeats measured adjacent in time has no error bar

admissibility.rule: ADMISSIBLE requires every check to hold. Any failure yields INDETERMINATE, and an INDETERMINATE record's ratios must be reported as not-quotable rather than quoted with a caveat.

generalisation_limit: These readings are one model (ResNet-50 v1 opset 12, f32) on one device (see `environment.device`), one driver, one ORT build, one day. They do not support any claim about ResNet on another GPU or vendor, about another model on this GPU, or about the Vulkan EP versus the CUDA EP in general. A single-device ratio is a reading, not parity.
